preconditions.description: The number of engineers N is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= current <= 2 * N for current, _ in preferences)
preconditions.description: Each current desk number is between 1 and 2N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= desired <= 2 * N for _, desired in preferences)
preconditions.description: Each desired desk number is between 1 and 2N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(set(current for current, _ in preferences)) == N
preconditions.description: No two engineers currently sit at the same desk.

postconditions.description: The number of possible assignments is returned modulo 1000000007.
The return value is the count of valid seating arrangements that meet the specified requirements.
